title: Bounded-size subobject surjecting onto a quotient
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian] with generator $U$. For an object $M$, let $|M|$ be the cardinality of its set of subobjects [lem-pur-kinjective-set-iso-classes-bounded-size]. Define $c(\lambda)=|\bigoplus_{\lambda}U|$. For every surjection $\pi:M\twoheadrightarrow N$ there exists a subobject $M'\subset M$ such that $M'\twoheadrightarrow N$ and $|M'|\le c(|N|)$.
